collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81dvbk_cl --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_bkcol_l --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-BK3 VERTICAL CUT (coordinator 0cj (b), 10-17 ~20:10): the bk clusters were ~1,160 um wide (the closed tiles' lane faces point away from the merger / control); they now stack inside the 680-um column (plan results/rtl/s81_dv_1016/bk_units_bk2/vcut_plan.json): S row 2 tiles, middle row merger-or-control + glue, N row 2 tiles (MX). Re-pinned top-down for the new neighbours; square-ish re-cut; the lane relays are gone (every hop <= ~405 um). Lane (220.32 x 151.2: the 259.2 x 216 trial measured TT 354.3 / spread 112.7 ps at 6% util): one master for all 4 lanes (S row R0, N row MX): t_w on the W half of the N face (to the merger), c_in on the E half (from the glue).
